verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only porting a number into Community Phone: free inbound transfer, a dedicated rep, and collection of the PIN, account number and Letter of Authorization from the losing carrier. Nothing documents porting out, port-out fees, or exposing an account number or transfer PIN in the app for a gaining carrier. 'No contracts, cancel anytime' bears on lock-in but is adjacent to the port-out capability, not evidence of it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
